title: Tom's Loot (Dp Edition)
description:
This datapack adds a variety of loot tables and can be used by other mod developers for structure mods and other mods with loot tables as a basis.
Datapack Edition
body: This is a data pack that adds loot tables; unlike the mod version of this data pack, it contains only vanilla loot tables. If you are developing structure data packs, mods, or anything else requiring loot tables, I would be happy for you to use this data pack as a base—or [alternatively, the more extensive mod version](https://modrinth.com/mod/toms-loot).
